items.headline: Source: Pats' Rhamondre Stevenson expected to miss time with knee tendon issue
items.description: Patriots top running back Rhamondre Stevenson is dealing with a knee tendon issue that is not expected to require surgery but could sideline him for a short period of time, a source told ESPN's Adam Schefter.
